explanation: recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_005.c:6958 tests the slot with an UNSIGNED comparison (v8 is unsigned int), so slot 0 (0-1 = 0xFFFFFFFF > 1) takes the per-item fold branch; the port's 'int slot' makes 'slot - 1 > 1' false at slot 0, so slot 0 is folded through the slots-1+2 sum branch instead. The sum is then XORed twice (slot 0 and slot 1) and cancels out and slot 0's own item id is never folded, so the packed-inventory hash differs from the original and stops changing when only slots 0/1/2 (the hand slots) change; the replicated counter unk_4a0 and the replicated item-id array unk_3b0 are then left stale, so equipment changes stop being replicated.
